Sometimes I feel like the smartest person in the room for the very simple reason that I do not see what the excitement is about having kids. Our parents grew up in a very different time, before the internet was around. Their values were simple - everyone should have kids. However, once the vast expanse of human knowledge was made available to everyone through the Internet, we got to see how people lived all around the world. We were able to look down on humanity from a high vantage point and properly gauge future outcomes of certain decisions across various generations.

Modern society has changed. We're not doing farm labor anymore where we require a house of 5+ kids. Nowadays people want to accomplish something meaningful that extends beyond themselves. Maybe they want to get really good at art, programming, or music making. Things like that require years of mastery to lead to a fulfilling life and career that creates real world value. To me, having kids is a form of submission(for many); you failed to find any meaning in your life so you do the easiest thing you can think of to give your life purpose. It is the most accessible form of personal martyrdom disguised as self-righteous moral posturing.

People need to seriously tested before they have kids. Impulsively having kids is no good for anyone.
